item.title: GitTube weekly digest: week 45, 2026 (2–8 Nov 2026)
item.description:
The best of GitHub this week (2–8 Nov 2026), picked from GitTube's lanes. This entry is refreshed daily until the week ends.

Rising fastest

  2. worldonlyu/Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto (Python) ★ 2,717, +1,274 this day: Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto
  3. Minireel/HGhub (TypeScript) ★ 1,343, +938 this day: YellowFruit third-party client
  4. deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype (TypeScript) ★ 19,966, +833 this day: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
  5. Gathin23/cleanyourtv (Python) ★ 52,934, +646 this day: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
